en.stage1Journal: Nearest 10: When we round to the nearest 10, we look at the ones digit. If it is 0 to 4, we round down to the lower multiple of 10. If it is 5 to 9, we round up to the next multiple of 10.
en.stage2Journal1: Nearest 100: When we round to the nearest 100, we look at the tens digit. If it is 0 to 4, we round down to the lower multiple of 100. If it is 5 to 9, we round up to the next multiple of 100.
en.stage2Journal2: Nearest 1,000: When we round to the nearest 1,000, we look at the hundreds digit. If it is 0 to 4, we round down to the lower multiple of 1,000. If it is 5 to 9, we round up to the next multiple of 1,000.
en.stage1Task1: Place the missing delivery zone numbers
en.stage1Task2: Deliver the packages to the delivery points.
en.stage1Task3: Round the number of packages to the nearest 10.
en.stage2Task1: Deliver the newspapers to the correct doorsteps
en.stage2Task2: Round the number of newspapers delivered to the nearest 100.
en.stage2Task3: Round the number of newspapers delivered to the nearest 1000.
en.stage1Text1: Good morning, Postbot. We have some packages that need delivering.
en.stage1Text2: It looks like some of the delivery zone locker signs along this street have fallen off. Let's put them back where they belong so we know where each package needs to go.
en.stage1Text3: Look at the number line at the top of the screen to see the delivery zones in numerical order. The numbers increase from left to right, even though the delivery zones may be on different sides of the street. Use the number line to help you see where each delivery zone belongs.
en.stage1Text4: You can move around using WASD or the arrow keys. Let's go and pick up a delivery zone sign, then place it where it belongs. First, let's have a look down the street.
en.stage1Text5: Here's a delivery zone sign. Pick it up using the E key and place it on the correct locker. You can open the map with the button in the top right or by pressing the M key.
en.stage1Text6: It looks like delivery zone 10's locker already has its sign. Look at the number line at the top of the screen to help you find where this sign belongs. When you think you have found the correct delivery zone locker, press E again to place it.
en.stage1Text7: Not quite. Remember, the delivery zone numbers get bigger as you move to the right along the number line. Try again.
en.stage1Text8: Well done! This delivery zone locker now has its sign in place. Let's do the same with the final 6 lockers.
en.stage1Text9: Excellent work, Postbot! Every delivery zone locker sign is back in place. Now the packages can finally be delivered.
en.stage1Text10: Each package has a delivery number, but it does not show the exact delivery zone. We need to round the number up or down to the nearest 10 to find the correct zone.
en.stage1Text11: This first package has the delivery number 11. There is no delivery zone 11 locker on this route, so we need to round 11 up or down to the nearest 10 and deliver the package to the correct delivery zone locker.
en.stage1Text12: When we round to the nearest 10, numbers from 10 to 14 round down to 10. Numbers from 15 to 19 round up to 20. Since 11 is closer to 10 than 20, we deliver this package to delivery zone 10.  Press J or the button in the top left if you need a reminder.
en.stage1Text13: Well done! This package belongs in delivery zone 10. The residents will be very happy that their delivery reached the correct zone. You're on your own for the next 2 packages. Good luck!
en.stage1Text14: Are you sure this package belongs in this delivery zone? Ask yourself which multiple of 10 the delivery number is closest to. Have another look and try again.
en.stage1Text16: Fantastic! You delivered the package to the correct delivery zone locker.
en.stage1Text18: Congratulations, Postbot! That's all our packages delivered.
en.stage1Text19: Great work! We have one final task. The sorting office needs an estimate of how many packages were processed today.
en.stage1Text20: Round the number of packages to the nearest 10 and type the value into the text box above.
en.stage1Text21: That’s not correct. Try again. When rounding to the nearest 10, look at the ones digit: 5 or more rounds up, 4 or less rounds down. Press J if you need help with rounding.
en.stage1Text22: Excellent job! I'll see you tomorrow for your newspaper route.
en.stage2Text1: Good morning, Postbot. Today we’re delivering newspapers, but instead of delivery depots, we're delivering to high-rise buildings.
en.stage2Text2: Each building is marked with a delivery zone number. Look at the delivery number on the form and round it to the nearest 100 to find the correct building.
en.stage2Text3: At the top of the list is delivery number 230. Round 230 to the nearest 100 to find the correct building. Off you go
en.stage2Text4: Now we're here. It looks like we can’t get close to the entrance, so we'll have to throw the newspaper.
en.stage2Text5: Press the Space bar to throw a newspaper. You can turn left and right using the A and D keys, or the Left and Right Arrow keys.
en.stage2Text6: Try to land the newspaper on the doorstep.
en.stage2Text7: Well done! You're on your own now. Follow the delivery report in order, rounding each address to find the correct doorstep.
en.stage2Text8: That's not quite right. Try again. Remember to round the delivery number to the nearest 100.
en.stage2Text9: Great job! That's all the newspapers delivered. Now, help the sorting office estimate how many packages were processed so far, by rounding the total to the nearest 100
en.stage2Text10: Type your answer into the text box.
en.stage2Text11: That’s not correct. Try again. When rounding to the nearest 100, look at the tens digit. When rounding to the nearest 1000, look at the hundreds digit. If that digit is 5 or more, round up; if it is 4 or less, round down. Press J if you need help with rounding.
en.stage2Text12: Excellent work! Let's head to the end of the street and complete our deliveries.
en.stage2Text13: Here we are on the final street of our newspaper round. These buildings are marked with delivery zone numbers in multiples of 1,000.
en.stage2Text14: I've updated your delivery list with five new delivery numbers. Round each number to the nearest 1,000 to find the correct building.
en.stage2Text15: Remember, if the hundreds digit is 5 or more, we round up to the next 1,000. For example, delivery number 1,500 rounds to 2,000.
en.stage2Text16: Work through the delivery report in order and throw each newspaper onto the correct doorstep. Off you go!
en.stage2Text17: Excellent work! Now, round the number of newspapers delivered today to the nearest 1,000.
en.stage2Text18: That's all our deliveries done. Well done. You were an excellent postbot. Thank you for your hard work.
